findings.title: Docs lack per-shell verify steps
findings.problem: Acceptance criterion 4 requires documentation explaining how to enable and verify completions separately for Bash, Zsh and Fish. The Bash, Zsh and Fish sections give enable steps only; the word 'verify' does not appear in the file.
findings.impact: Required story criterion is partially unmet; users cannot confirm that completions loaded.
findings.recommendation: Add a 'Verify' step to each of the Bash, Zsh and Fish sections (for example type `codemie <Tab>` and the expected top-level commands), and align the doc with the final decisions on root options and file fallback.
findings.check_notes: Verify steps added for bash, zsh and fish in docs/SHELL-COMPLETIONS.md

fix.change: Added a Verify step to the Bash, Zsh and Fish sections of SHELL-COMPLETIONS.md

findings.title: Valued options lack file-completion fallback
findings.problem: Spec says valued options without choices fall back to file completion. PATH_PLACEHOLDER = /[<[](path|file|dir)[>\]]/i matches only exact placeholder names, so `<filePath>`, `<directory>`, `<config-file>` and every other valued option offer nothing (kind 'value').
findings.impact: Path-valued options get no completion in any shell; tests and docs lock in the divergent behavior.
findings.recommendation: Fall back to file completion for valued options with no choices (or widen the regex to include directory, filepath, output and variants), then update tests and docs.
findings.check_notes: tree.ts: valued options without choices (except --task) are path kind; snapshots and test updated

fix.change: Valued options without choices now get file completion (--task stays value-less); snapshots and docs updated

findings.title: Root options offered at every node
findings.problem: Spec states global options are not inherited (only root offers --task, -V, --version). effectiveOptions merges root options into every node; snapshots, integration tests and docs assert the inverse. A tree.ts comment says Commander empirically accepts them there.
findings.impact: Tab after a subcommand suggests --version/-V/--task, which may not be real options of that command (criterion 3: suggestions reflect the real interface). Which behavior is intended needs a human decision.
findings.recommendation: Decide: follow the spec (offer root options only at root) or amend the spec and docs to match the verified inherited behavior; then align tree.ts, snapshots, tests and docs.
findings.check_notes: Decision recorded: keep inherited root options; docs amended

fix.change: Decision: keep inherited root options; spec.md and SHELL-COMPLETIONS.md amended to match

decision.outcome: Keep inherited root options at every node; amend spec and docs
decision.rationale: CLI accepts root options after a subcommand (codemie list --version)

findings.title: Root options before completion bypass silencing
findings.problem: completion is detected only as argv[2] === 'completion'. `codemie --debug completion bash` (any root option first) skips the quiet path, so migrations, the update prompt and the what's-new notice can write to stdout. The spec also asks for silencing through getInvocationContext/shouldRunUpgradeNotice; whatsnew.ts is unchanged and bin/codemie.js uses call-site guards.
findings.impact: Eval'ed or redirected script can be corrupted when a root option precedes the command. Trigger is uncommon, but failure is silent.
findings.recommendation: Detect the first non-dash argv word, e.g. `argv.slice(2).find(a => !a.startsWith('-')) === 'completion'` (account for valued root options), and route it through the shared silent/output-contract path including shouldRunUpgradeNotice.
findings.check_notes: firstCommandWord skips root options and --task value; bin/codemie.js guards use invocation.completion; test added

fix.change: Completion detection takes the first non-option word, skipping --task's value

findings.title: Ticket key in all commit subjects
findings.problem: Standards review: git-workflow.md lists the ticket key in the commit subject as an anti-pattern (reference it in the body footer). All 10 commits carry EPMCDME-17673 in the subject. Commit-format is a blocking standard.
findings.impact: Blocks the workflow standard; rewording requires rewriting history, which needs a human decision (squash-merge title may make it moot).
findings.recommendation: Reword subjects without the ticket key and put it in the body footer, or confirm the squash-merge title covers it and accept the deviation.
findings.check_notes: Decision recorded with rationale; pending caller action: reword 10 local commit subjects then re-pin

findings.title: Completion errors may be swallowed
findings.problem: The logger console sink is nulled for completion; a generate failure logged via logger would not reach stderr.
findings.impact: Narrow trigger: generate failing is unlikely; Commander argument errors still print.
findings.recommendation: Route the logger console to stderr for completion instead of null.

findings.title: Option terminator -- not handled in walk
findings.problem: Words after `--` that start with '-' are treated as options, so the tracked node can desync.
findings.impact: Rare sequence; wrong suggestions only, easily avoided.
findings.recommendation: Treat `--` as end of options in the bash, zsh and fish walkers.

findings.title: readVersion silently falls back to 1.0.0
findings.problem: readVersion swallows all errors and returns '1.0.0', so a wrong stamp appears in the header used to detect stale scripts.
findings.impact: Only when package.json cannot be read; misleads stale-script detection.
findings.recommendation: Throw a clear error instead of returning a fake version.

findings.title: Positional choices not completed
findings.problem: Only option choices are modelled; `codemie completion <Tab>` does not offer bash/zsh/fish and `codemie help <Tab>` offers no command names.
findings.impact: Convenience gap; subcommands and options are still offered. Docs do not mention it.
findings.recommendation: Model positional argument choices, or document the limitation.
